content.short: Duo is the first humor based play-to-earn NFT card game on Cardano. We are putting humanity's humor to the test.
content.description:
We all deserve to laugh more. Duo is the first play-to-earn humor-based social NFT game built on Cardano. NFT gaming is the next wave of crypto adoption, and Duo gameplay is designed to be an easy-entry NFT game with enjoyable gameplay for all levels of crypto users. In Duo, black cards act as prompts, while color cards deliver a variety of funny quips. The best pair (as selected by a judge) wins that round. Best of all, you can earn real crypto when you play either card type! We've already seen tremendous growth so far, so don't miss out on this opportunity to join this new segment of the crypto industry. Let's put humanity's humor to the test.
